name: CineHub
objective: Build a movie discovery app with rich metadata and streaming info
description: CineHub is a full-stack movie discovery platform that aggregates data from TMDB API, providing users with trending movies, detailed information, and streaming availability.

name: RASM
objective: Create an immersive portfolio experience with RPG-inspired design
description: RASM is a personal portfolio website designed as an immersive RPG experience. It features a Nordic fantasy theme with animated opening scenes, sound effects, and a unique navigation system.
